notes: Detailed Rack: a new item now takes both faces by default, so occupying a unit on the front mirrors it on the back and vice versa; Front only or Back only remain a choice
Switch and UPS objects can be placed into the Detailed Rack from the item dialog's Object dropdown, with their Rack Units and a Rack position shown in their popup and in Excel
Network Rack Detailed View: front and back of the rack at its unit count, items of 1 to N units, per-slot notes, drag items to move or swap them
The rack elevation prints on each rack's Excel tab and, under the PDF layer Network Rack Detailed View, on an appendix page per rack
A cable drawn between a rack and a device fills its Nearest Net Rack automatically
New UPS object with its own icon, popup, PDF layer and Excel tab
Excel: Ethernet Cables and Fiber Cables are separate tabs
